name: io.infarm/mcp-gdal
description: GDAL and OGR raster, vector, coordinate reference system and virtual filesystem tools for AI agents.

environmentVariables.name: INFARM_MCP_GDAL_ALLOWEDROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Directories that the tools may read and write, separated by ';'. The local filesystem is unrestricted when the variable is not set.

environmentVariables.name: INFARM_MCP_GDAL_READONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to reject every operation that writes outside /vsimem/.
